tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[Cut locus of a sphere] 1. ch13:2.3If $M^n=S^n$ and $p\in S^n$, the cut locus of $p$ is its antipodal point. Here the cut locus of $p$ coincides with the locus of conjugate points to $p$. \end{example}
